//: Scoop manifest for the Pulse CLI. The source repo is PRIVATE, so downloads go through the public release proxy (updates.streamflowmesh.io/download/<tag>/<asset>), never github.com. Publish it into a bucket repo you own (e.g. olsisoft/scoop-bucket as pulse.json) so Windows users can: `scoop bucket add pulse https://github.com/olsisoft/scoop-bucket ; scoop install pulse`. Per release, update version + the hash (the .sha256 files are proxied next to each asset). This installs the self-contained app-image (a native launcher + an embedded JRE — NO JDK needed): the .zip auto-extracts to a pulse/ dir; with extract_dir 'pulse' that dir becomes the app root and Scoop shims its pulse.exe (jpackage puts the Windows launcher at the app-image root, not under bin/). See docs/PULSE-CLI-DISTRIBUTION.md.
description: Pulse — declare a real-time app in YAML; it compiles to an API, SDKs and a UI.
